008package paint.viewer.control;
009
010import paint.viewer.ui.panels.SquareGridPanel;
011import paint.viewer.model.SquareControlParams;
012
013/**
014 * Handles configuration and control of a {@link SquareGridPanel}
015 * by applying user-defined visibility and threshold parameters.
016 */
017public class SquareControlHandler {
018
019    private SquareGridPanel grid;
020
021
022    /**
023     * Applies the specified square control parameters to a grid panel.
024     * <p>
025     * If a panel is provided, it becomes the active target. If no panel
026     * is given, the method applies the parameters to the currently
027     * attached grid.
028     * </p>
029     *
030     * @param params the square control parameters including density ratio,
031     *               variability, R², and neighbour mode
032     * @param panel  optional {@link SquareGridPanel} target; if null, the
033     *               currently attached grid is used
034     */
035    public void apply(SquareControlParams params, SquareGridPanel panel) {
036        if (panel != null) {
037            this.grid = panel;
038        }
039        if (grid == null) {
040            return;
041        }
042
043        grid.setControlParameters(
044                params.minRequiredDensityRatio,
045                params.maxAllowableVariability,
046                params.minRequiredRSquared,
047                params.neighbourMode
048        );
049        grid.applyVisibilityFilter();
050    }
051}
